rules.action: Moves through interactive content inside the current article and on to the next article's content in reading order; articles themselves are focusable so the feed commands below work.
Moves focus to the next article (the APG feed command).
Moves focus to the previous article.
Moves focus to the first focusable element after the feed in the document; with `hasMore`, instead triggers a load (press again once it has loaded and `hasMore` is false).
Moves focus to the new-items button when shown, else to the last focusable element before the feed in the document.
